scope: Canonical agent_doc namespace, ordinary project doc preservation, registered immutable legacy result reads across three readers, current plan binding and guide guards; Linux functional regression only, not model compliance or OS sandboxing.

implementation.procedure: Inspect canonical task/results paths, installed entry and three registered read-only legacy consumers; new writes remain canonical.
implementation.acceptance: Only the selected project receives its document layout; source repository tasks are not imported.

reference_boundary.procedure: Fresh init with ordinary doc and two projects, both guide namespaces, legacy mapping success/refusal/collision/tamper and managed current_inputs; stale old snapshots reject.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Projects stay separate; existing files preserved; refusals happen before new document writes; no guide file created.

data_integrity.procedure: Bind executed source snapshot, commands, verbose raw logs, environment and checker; account for each test outcome.
data_integrity.acceptance: Frozen source and raw verbose outcomes agree; all pre-move frozen result bytes and GUIDE preserved. Legacy mapping does not rewrite manifests or grant acceptance.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute integer test denominators and skips from verbose outcome lines.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Nonempty denominator equals passed plus skipped; no failure or error.

measurement_validity.procedure: Identify scope of functional authored checks.
measurement_validity.acceptance: No performance, actual-model behavior or universal correctness inference.

reproducibility.procedure: Controller-injected independent host process reruns fresh target initialization/refusal checks and verifies bound source and data.
reproducibility.acceptance: Fresh replay and required regression commands succeed against the bound version.
